notes.title: Release Announcement! Steam Cloud Check.
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Everyone! 
Siluman here!

We’re super excited to share that [b]Monmusu Paradise Visitor[/b] is ready for release, but there’s might be a slight delay. The [b]Cloud Save[/b] feature is still waiting for confirmation from [b]Steam[/b] before we can roll it out.
I am sorry for the inconvenience and we will release the game ASAP when we are cleared by the system so you can enjoy our world. *The updates will follow after as we promised too.[/p][p]Unfortunately, this delay is might because a lot of things happened, but we're positively hope everything will be alright going forward.[/p][p]We’re working hard to ensure everything is properly sorted out as soon as possible. We truly appreciate your patience and support as we navigate this process, and we’ll keep you updated with any new developments![/p][p]Stay tuned, and thank you again for your understanding![/p][p]
Best,

Siluman[/p]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix Patch Balance
notes.notes:
Updating some balance and buttons for better playing experience:
- speed up walking for fishing 
- updating lighting for fishing
- shorten the walking distance when out of area
- updating the keyboard inputs so it can use full controller than just keyboard
- adding more buttons for menus
- adding key manual in description

Keyboard
======================
Movement : Arrow Keys
Accept : Z/Enter
Cancel : X/Esc/Tab/Space
Menu : Esc/Tab/Space

Controller
======================
Movement : D-Pad
Accept : A
Cancel : B
Menu : Start
